provenance.statement: NOT a live SO-101 hardware Shadow capture. This analysis session has no SO-101 hardware attached (no /dev/serial/by-id/*, no /dev/video*), so scripts/run_shadow_mode.py could not be run for this scene. Built instead from the held-out local/so101_cube_xy_midpoint_test10_v2_clean dataset (never used in training) by taking episode 3's frame_index=0 (state + first workspace/wrist frame) as this scene's reference observation, per explicit user decision (2026-08-08).
